## Gene panel filter

```{r gene-filter-note}
table_details(
  summary = "What the panel filter applies to",
  "Applies to both the small-variant and structural-variant tables below. Tick any number",
  "of panels: a variant or SV is kept if it hits", tags$strong("any"), "of them, and with none",
  "ticked the tables are unfiltered. Small variants match on gene symbol; SVs match on",
  "breakend position when the panel carries coordinates — see the note under the SV table",
  "for which mode each ticked panel is in.",
  tags$br(),
  "With more than one panel ticked, each panel_hit entry names the panel it matched in",
  "square brackets.",
  tags$br(),
  "A custom list is bare symbols, which carry no coordinates, so its SVs are matched on",
  "the annotated breakend genes only — no positional window."
)
```

```{r gene-filter-ui, results='asis'}
# One checkbox per registered panel. There is no "all genes" entry: no box ticked *is*
# the unfiltered state, which is one fewer sentinel to keep in sync than the old
# "__all__" <option> was. The boxes ticked on load are params$default_panels, and the
# handler in per_sample.qmd reads its initial state back off these attributes.
all_p = if (!is.null(params$all_panels) && length(params$all_panels) > 0)
          params$all_panels else list()
selected = setdiff(as.character(unlist(params$default_panels)), "__all__")

chip = function(value, label) {
  paste0('  <label class="panel-toggle', if (value %in% selected) " is-on" else "", '">',
         '<input type="checkbox" class="panel-checkbox" value="',
         htmltools::htmlEscape(value, attribute = TRUE), '"',
         if (value %in% selected) " checked" else "", '> ',
         htmltools::htmlEscape(label), '</label>\n')
}

chips = ""
for (nm in names(all_p)) {
  label = paste0(toupper(substr(nm, 1, 1)), substr(nm, 2, nchar(nm)))
  chips = paste0(chips, chip(nm, label))
}
chips = paste0(chips, chip("__custom__", "Custom…"))

cat(paste0('
<div class="panel-controls">
  <span class="panel-controls__label">Gene panels:</span>
  <div class="panel-controls__toggles">
', chips, '  </div>
  <button type="button" id="panel-clear" class="panel-controls__clear">Clear</button>
  <!-- Unhidden by assets/js/facet_filter.js whenever a column tickbox filter is set. It
       sits here rather than by the tables because with scrollY = "400px" a ticked filter
       can be scrolled out of sight, and inside .panel-controls it inherits the print
       hiding for free. It shares .panel-controls__clear with the panel Clear beside it —
       two neutral secondary controls in one bar — so restyling one restyles both. -->
  <button type="button" id="facet-clear" class="panel-controls__clear" hidden>Clear value filters</button>
  <span id="panel-variant-count" class="panel-controls__count"></span>
</div>
<div id="custom-gene-panel" class="panel-controls__custom-area" style="display:none;">
  <label>Custom genes — one per line, or comma/space separated, case-insensitive:</label>
  <textarea id="custom-gene-input" rows="4"></textarea>
</div>
'))
```
